notes:
Population (residents): Zensus 2022 100 m × 100 m population grid (Destatis). Grid cells in the bounding box aggregated to 500 m cells; each non-empty cell becomes one demand point placed at the cell centroid. Cell population = sum of constituent 100 m cells.

Jobs: Bundesagentur für Arbeit, table 13111-01-03 (sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschäftigte, municipality level, 2023). Municipal totals distributed across OSM buildings within each municipality, weighted by building footprint area and type (commercial, office, industrial, retail). 15 special demand points (universities, hospital, industrial clusters, airport) assigned fixed job counts based on publicly known workforce sizes.

Commute flows (pops): 69,325 origin-destination pairs generated to match Bundesagentur für Arbeit Pendlerstatistik at Kreis (county) level. Driving times and distances per O-D pair computed with OSRM on a local extract of the Saxony + Saxony-Anhalt OSM network. Pop sizes calibrated to reproduce observed Kreis-to-Kreis flow totals. Street geometries stored separately in driving_paths.json.gz (1-based positional index into pops list).

Special demand: 15 demand points represent major non-residential destinations (Universität Leipzig, HTWK, Martin-Luther-Universität Halle, Universitätsklinikum, Messe Leipzig, Red Bull Arena, Zoo Leipzig, main stations, airport LEJ, BMW plant, DHL hub, chemical industry Leuna/Bitterfeld). These carry jobs but zero residents. Airport demand uses time-smoothed distribution; universities use commuter-style timing.

Data vintage: Zensus 2022, BA employment 2023, OSM extract 2024-Q4 (Geofabrik). — Reviewer refinements (2026-08-26): workplace_count scored physical_inferred, not physical_measured — BA 13111 SvB counts are a register the statistics office links to work location (same source and rung as the muenchen submission), not a census place-of-work question. Workplace resolution pinned to osm_footprints (the methodology places on OSM buildings, not Overture). Resident side UPGRADED from the filed answers: the "spread evenly" placement answer contradicts the methodology — the Zensus 2022 100m grid carries measured per-cell counts used directly, so granularity is mesh_125 with measured_per_unit intensity; the 500m demand-point aggregation is point-placement detail the rubric deliberately does not score. O/D confirmed as filed: the BA Pendlerstatistik Kreis-to-Kreis table is a real full matrix at ADM2 grain; the 69k fine O-D pairs synthesized to match it are modeling, and the grain multiplier prices the coarseness.
